still_wrong.title: Chain corners still read as V hooks, and in print the bar breaks the line at the corner
still_wrong.detail: The arrowhead is off the corner now, but corners up to 144 degrees are kept. Strip to disk has 3 paths live and 2 in the figure, and all of them are V-shaped hooks. In the Article B/W figure the bar's white halo (stroke 0.35, paint-order stroke) cuts both legs at the V's tip. The corner then shows as a gap with a loose slash beside it, so it reads as a broken path and not as 'the step changes here'. The same gap shows at one Cayley-cube bar (lower middle).
still_wrong.evidence: Live __cmwPathsCheck at t = end: Strip to disk kinkStep 2.52 rad. verify-shots/z_striptodisk-fig-bar.png (4x crop of after/review/striptodisk-export-article-bw.png), z_cayleycube-fig.png, z_striptodisk-live-corner.png.
still_wrong.fix: In print, draw the bar with no white halo (or a halo only on the bar's ends), or draw a small open node at the corner instead of a bar. Lower the kept corner limit to about 120 degrees, or require both legs to be at least 2 dS for any corner over 100 degrees.

still_wrong.title: A path's own second leg passes 4 px from its own start ring
still_wrong.detail: The ring and dot clearance tests check other paths only. In Strip to disk (live, t = end), the path from z = 0.642 + 1.566i goes up to the imaginary axis and comes back down, and its return leg runs 4.1 px from its own ring. On screen the ring sits on the line.
still_wrong.evidence: Own measure from __cmwMorphSel paths: Strip to disk ownRing 4.1 px (all other paths in the 7 examples 17-30 px). verify-shots/z_striptodisk-live-corner.png (right path).
still_wrong.fix: Apply the dE/2 ring and end-dot clearance to the path's own line too, beyond its first and last dS of arclength.

still_wrong.title: Cayley-cube still has two long parallel lines, and the ink cap is skipped for the first 4 paths
still_wrong.detail: Live at t = end, the paths from 1.12 + 0.23i and 1.24 + 0.84i run as two near-parallel straight legs for about 180 px, within 30 px of each other (within 40 px for about 285 px). sepLong is 0.25, exactly at the limit. The ink is 2066 px against a cap of about 1721 (2.5 x sqrt(848 x 559)), because pathsGen applies the cap only once 4 paths are kept (line 4434). On the phone, sepLong is again 0.247.
still_wrong.evidence: __cmwPathsCheck at t = end: sepLong 0.25, ink 2066. Own measure: 178 of 668 px and 182 of 494 px within 30 px of another path. verify-shots/cayleycube-light-end.png (the two diagonals from the upper right).
still_wrong.fix: Apply the ink cap from the second path on (or with a minimum of 2, not 4). Make longShare a strict margin (for example 0.2), or measure it at 2.2 dTest, so that pairs at the limit are dropped.
